mentions.name: AstraView
mentions.description: AstraView is an astronomy app that lets users create custom horizon profiles for one or more locations and predicts which celestial objects (galaxies, deep sky objects, planets, etc.) can be seen and when based on their specific views. It includes built-in cloud forecasts and other features aimed at amateur astronomers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently released https://astraview.app It's an astronomy app that lets you create custom horizon profiles for one or more locations and predicts what can be seen (galaxies, deep sky objects, planets etc) and when according to your specific views. It also has built in cloud forecasts and many other useful features for amateur astronomers
